deviceChecklist.reason: No actual Xiaomi hardware/Chrome run in this worktree.
Installed-PWA keyboard open/close/Back requires a real device.
Resize/reflow proxy is not actual browser zoom.
400% actual browser zoom unavailable in this harness.
200% text/spacing is separate from viewport resize.
Keyboard emulation does not prove physical keyboard/safe-area behavior.
Notch/home-indicator geometry needs a real device.
OS keyboard resize/scroll behavior needs a real device.
Reduced-motion can be emulated, but device/browser behavior remains separate.
Native OS/browser date picker cancel/reopen is not automatable in headless Chrome; shared calendar Dialog cancel/reopen is covered, native picker is not.

assertions.no-document-horizontal-overflow: documentElement/body scrollWidth must not exceed clientWidth for the case, except a named local table region.
assertions.control-targets: standard actions >=48px, compact actions >=44px; measure rendered rects.
assertions.control-radius-10: approved 10px control radius retained; no new radius.
assertions.label-error-association: label htmlFor and aria-describedby/error id resolve to the control/visible text.
assertions.no-overlap: visible interactive/sticky/status boxes do not intersect in a way that covers a decision or focused control.
assertions.focus-reachable: focused control is within viewport and elementFromPoint returns it/descendant, not sticky chrome.
assertions.single-vertical-scroll: one intended page scroll owner; no nested vertical trap.
assertions.mobile-charts-visible: phone Home renders owner-mini-chart/owner-mini-donut; desktop owner-chart measured separately.
assertions.exact-money-context: amounts, sign, period, location and outstanding/overdue relationship remain exact.
assertions.table-scroll-region: a sideways table has a local overflow region with accessible name/focus path where required.
assertions.filter-restoration: query/status/scroll/day/selection retained after detail/back and resize where safe.
assertions.dialog-cancel-restore: Escape/close/cancel closes, restores focus and preserves valid draft.
assertions.date-format-validation: dd/mm/yyyy display, ISO paste/output, invalid/leap/old-year handling and required DOB/guardian/consent unchanged.
assertions.permission-scope: accountant only sees authorized destinations; settings 404; context change re-scopes state.
assertions.honest-state: empty/no matches/loading/offline/error/unknown are distinct; no false saved/sent/paid.
assertions.reduced-motion: prefers-reduced-motion removes non-essential animation; charts/dialogs remain usable.
assertions.no-new-dependency: no @playwright/test, axe or other install; reuse existing Playwright/Vitest.
